description: This file defines the Ec2ParamBuilder class, a specialized serializer component used for building query parameters for EC2 API calls within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends QueryParamBuilder and provides methods for determining query names, handling flat structures, and formatting list shapes in request parameters.

classes.name: Ec2ParamBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing EC2-specific query parameters for AWS SDK PHP API requests, extending general query parameter building logic.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the query name for a shape, defaulting to the 'queryName' attribute or a capitalized 'locationName'.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Indicates whether the shape is flat; always returns false for EC2 query serialization.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Formats a list shape into query parameters, handling empty lists and iterating over list items to serialize each.
